verdict.rationale: Pricing changes for existing subscribers are a fair question for a billing and invoicing product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents a reusable list of products and prices and one-time invoice products. Nothing covers versioned plans, grandfathering existing subscribers, or bulk migration of cohorts to new prices, and a reusable price list is an adjacent feature that earns no credit.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can change pricing without breaking existing subscribers — versioned plans, grandfathering, and bulk migration tools for moving cohorts to new prices
